definitionZh: * moz-Progress-bar CSS伪元素是Mozilla扩展,代表进度元素内的进度棒. (该栏代表已取得的进展。 )
sourceDefinition: The ::-moz-progress-bar CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the progress bar inside a progress element. (The bar represents the amount of progress that has been made.)

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The ::-moz-progress-bar CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the progress bar inside a progress element. (The bar represents the amount of progress that has been made.)
